answer: Completed the full workflow. analysis.py (single coherent, runnable script, no forbidden APIs, native-grid alignment only) executes in ~4 s and produces all seven required artifacts. Core: exact per-point inversion of the symmetric Fabry–Pérot slab model with unique passive-root selection (|P|<=1 holds at all 756 calibration points; the inversion quadratic's roots multiply to 1, so passivity picks the physical branch), giving n(lambda), Z(lambda) per calibration sample. Compact families are wavelength-domain Lorentz oscillators for eps/mu; all three required families were fitted per sample and compared through a low-dimensional linear geometry->parameter transfer map with leave-one-sample-out cross validation of the full geometry->parameters->forward-model chain: electric_only LOO RMSE 0.245, electric_magnetic_dual_resonance 0.040, dual_resonance_plus_substrate_shift 0.040 (substrate coefficient ~0, no improvement). Parsimony rule selected electric_magnetic_dual_resonance (8 per-sample parameters), and only this family produced the calibration retrieval, held-out predictions, and negative-index summary. Held-out predictions are generated solely by the selected family via the map (no interpolation/surrogate APIs; round-trip inversion of the predicted S-parameters reproduces the predicted n to machine precision; predicted curves are passive with Im(n)>=0.06). Negative-index summary: all six calibration samples and all three held-out samples show finite negative bands (calibration widths 86-121 nm; H1 1682.9-1726.0 nm — flagged as truncated at the grid edge, H2 1346.1-1424.4 nm, H3 1592.8-1710.3 nm); the zero-width no-band convention is implemented and would be applied automatically if a sample showed no robust band. Diagnostics PNG (matplotlib unavailable in the environment, so a self-contained numpy+zlib PNG fallback renderer was built in; matplotlib path kept for richer runtimes) shows per-point vs family n_real with shaded bands, forward-model reconstruction residuals (floor ~0.014, consistent with the effective noise level), and phase-branch consistency (per-step unwrapped-phase advances << pi, finite passivity margins). All CSV schemas match retrieval_notes.md exactly.
